description: Free. Who funded a Solana wallet (a pump.fun dev, a buyer, any address): who sent it its first SOL, who funded that wallet, up to five hops back, each with the amount, the time and the transaction; where the walk stopped (a wallet with more than 5,000 transactions, the mark of an exchange, a service or a bot, ends it); and which other walked wallets got their first SOL from the same address. For: who is behind this dev, where did this wallet's money come from, are these wallets funded by the same address. Read from the chain; facts, no verdict.
name: who_funded
